correctness.rationale: Exact generator algebra gives \(L(y^2+z^2)=-2cy^2-2bz\) and \(Lz=-b+xy\). Compact-support invariance yields the two stationary identities. With \(b,c>0\), \(\int xy\,d\mu=b\) excludes \(y=0\) almost surely, so \(\int y^2\,d\mu>0\) and hence \(\int z\,d\mu<0\). Any compact invariant set in \(z\ge0\) would support an invariant probability measure and contradict this sign. For ergodic measures, Liouville plus the ergodic theorem identifies the sum of Lyapunov exponents with mean divergence, giving the displayed exact formula. The included checker replays the polynomial identities exactly; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result constrains every compact recurrent state of a published no-equilibrium hyperchaotic model. It forces strictly negative mean height, excludes compact invariant dynamics from the entire half-space \(z\ge0\), and turns a pointwise divergence expression into an exact Lyapunov-sum law. These are reusable structural checks for periodic, quasiperiodic, chaotic, or hyperchaotic recurrent regimes and are materially stronger than recomputing one trajectory or one table entry.
